be noted that zeros of the Davenport–Heilbronn zeta-function have been subject to
much analysis. Spira [16] calculated the location of some of zeros of the Davenport–
Heilbronn zeta-function off the critical line σ = 1/2 in the region 0 ≤ t ≤ 200, see
also Balanzario and Sánchez-Ortiz [1]. He did not find any zeros of its derivative left
off σ = 1/2 in this region although he did find several locations of zeros of the function
itself. This would go against our Theorem 1.2. However, we recalculated zeros of the
derivative of the Davenport–Heilbronn zeta-function and we did find zeros left off the
critical line with imaginary parts less than 200.
